subject: Post-call: monthly spend anchor & PO banding — next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: monthly spend anchor & PO banding — next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap from our discovery call and two asks so we can route this through procurement quickly.

Key points from call
- Primary workload: interactive chat for customer support (avg prompt+response ~120 tokens).
- Expected peak concurrency: ~50 concurrent agents, estimated steady-state QPS ~12.
- Rough monthly usage: 200M–600M tokens (current projection range; you mentioned pilot first month then ramp).
- Target unit economics: you called out ~$350–$450 per 1M tokens as a target to be competitive.

Asks / clarifying questions
1) Can you confirm the correct monthly budget band to qualify for a standard PO (vs full MSA)? In our experience: vendors in your procurement process typically allow up to $50k–$75k on a standard PO; anything above often needs additional onboarding steps.
2) Who is the procurement contact (email) to receive the pricing worksheet and a short procurement note?

What I attached
- redwood-pricing-worksheet-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) — preliminary pricing tiers across monthly buckets and recommended batching/quantization levers to hit target $/1M.

Suggested next steps (if that works for you)
- You confirm budget band and procurement contact — we’ll push a compact PO-ready pricing summary.
- If budget is > $75k/month, we can surface the MSA + SOW path; Ben (cc’d) will coordinate legal/finance handoff.
- Quick follow-up call (15m) with procurement if you want a live walk-through — available tomorrow morning.

Thanks — I’ll hold on preparing a tailored price table once you confirm the two items above.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightai.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: monthly spend anchor & PO banding — next steps

Thanks Camila — summary looks right. Two quick clarifications from our side:

- Monthly band: for the pilot we can start in the $20k–$40k bracket (we prefer conservative commits for month 1). If the pilot metrics look good we expect to move to $100k+/month by month 3.
- Unit economics: the $350–$450/1M tokens target is accurate; procurement will want to see a conservative and a committed rate side-by-side.
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightai.com (please cc this mailbox).

I attached our internal purchasing thresholds — it shows that anything above $50k in a single PO requires SCAR review and an approved vendor questionnaire.

We’re fine receiving the PO-ready pricing summary for the pilot band. If we hit the metrics, we’ll look to expedite the MSA.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, BrightAI
Samantha.lee@brightai.com

Attachment: brightai-procurement-limits.pdf (policy excerpt)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@brightai.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: monthly spend anchor & PO banding — next steps

Great — appreciate the clarity. Action items on our side: 
- I’ll send a two-row pricing summary today: (1) pilot band (20k–40k monthly) with a conservative rate, (2) committed volume discount for 100k+/month with target $/1M to approach your $350–$450 goal.
- Ben will engage legal for an MSA template and estimate lead time for SCAR review if/when you exceed the $50k PO threshold.

Quick note on unit economics assumptions I’ll use for the price table (call out so we’re aligned):
- Avg tokens per interaction: 120 tokens (you confirmed).
- Effective tokens/month (pilot): assume 200M tokens for sizing the conservative row.
- Quantization/batching recommendations included in the worksheet to hit edge of target cost.

If procurement prefers, we can produce both: a PO-ready PDF (for procurement mailbox) and a one-page MSA summary (for legal). Which would you prefer to receive first?

On schedule: I can send the PO-ready PDF this afternoon and the detailed sheet to your procurement mailbox.

—
Camila
